verdict.rationale: Wave's docs say it uses 'real, double-entry accounting' and lets users 'create unlimited... bookkeeping records', which implies balanced debit/credit postings underneath. However, no evidence shows a user-facing manual journal entry screen, balance enforcement, or memo fields. Missing for 10: explicit manual journal entry feature documentation, debit/credit balancing validation, supporting memo/attachment fields on entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
